question: What is a cost function in machine learning?
direct_answer: A cost function is the quantity a model tries to minimize during training.
expanded_answer: A cost function maps predictions and true targets to a real-valued measure of error. Training adjusts model parameters to reduce this value, so the model fits the training data better according to the chosen objective.
key_points: Maps predictions and targets to a scalar
Defines what counts as 'better' for the model
common_wrong_ideas: It is only a metric for reporting after training
It is the same thing as model accuracy
It is independent of the training objective
